overview_description.description: Datafold is the data engineering automation platform. We combine specialized AI agents for data platform migration and optimization with the Data Knowledge Graph — a comprehensive context layer served via MCP — so data teams and their coding agents ship higher-quality data faster and reliably.

about_short_description.short_description: Datafold automates data engineering with AI

product.name: Datafold Migration Agent
product.description: An AI-powered tool that automates the translation of legacy SQL and ETL code into modern SQL dialects and transformation frameworks, ensuring data parity during migrations.

product.name: Data Diff
product.description: A feature that compares data at the value level between two datasets or databases to identify discrepancies and ensure data accuracy.

product.name: Datafold Monitors
product.description: A monitoring system that continuously checks data quality through scheduled data diffs, anomaly detection, schema change alerts, and data tests.

product.name: Automated Code Review with AI
product.description: An AI-driven tool that analyzes SQL code changes in pull requests to enforce custom coding standards and identify potential data issues.

product.name: Column-Level Lineage
product.description: A system that maps detailed data lineage at the column level across data warehouses, transformation models, and BI tools.

product.name: File and NoSQL Diffing
product.description: Capability to compare data stored in files and NoSQL databases like MongoDB to identify differences and validate data quality.
